preregistration.intent: Descriptive screen only. Reports how the frozen v2 predictions are distributed across strata that the organisers provided, so prediction patterns can be reviewed. This is not model promotion, not a validation score, and not an accuracy assessment; no organiser target is estimated or implied.
preregistration.quantile_method: nearest-rank on the ascending sorted group values: index = max(0, ceil(q * n) - 1); deterministic and independent of interpolation

arithmetic.mean: float64 sum divided by n, and independently an exact rational sum of the decimal strings divided by n
arithmetic.contrast: max group mean minus min group mean over the stratum's present groups
arithmetic.reproduction: abs(float contrast - exact rational contrast) must be <= contrast_tolerance for every stratum

missing_strata_policy.declared: Every stratum group is formed only from a non-null provided value. Nulls fall into the single explicit missing label; they are never zero-filled, region-mean filled, or dropped from the stratum total.
missing_strata_policy.absent_column: A stratum whose column is absent from the provided schema is reported with status not_available_in_provided_inputs, zero groups, and is never imputed.
missing_strata_policy.derived_undefined: Derived strata record an explicit undefined label for mathematically undefined operands (for example zero land area) instead of imputing a value.

measure_before.statement: Previous strata discovery reports analyse C2/C3-era predictors and provided-feature prevalence; no descriptive distribution of the frozen v2 candidate across the same strata was recorded.

reports/discovery-rural-svi-minority.jso.subject: rural x upper-quartile provided svi_minority field, South-Central Texas

strata_family_provenance.provided_input_file: defined-flags-inputs/<region>-strata-tract-table.parquet (organiser-provided, hashed against the frozen input-provenance manifest)
strata_family_provenance.documentation: docs/data-inventory.md records the provided strata schema column-by-column for every region
strata_family_provenance.note: SVI, CVI, RUCA/RUCC, NCHS, tribal, USDM, USFS, MTBS, NIFC, FOD, GEHE, HWD/UHE, PMDI/SPI and CarbonPlan columns are organiser-provided equity/hazard strata inside that provided file. They are not the removed reference layers (TIGER roads, MS Buildings, USGS facilities, CBP establishments), which are absent from every provided file and are never read here. Because the frozen scored candidate may not read these strata columns, every column outside the permitted model-input subset is descriptive-only and its absence from every model-chain script is measured.

share of tract population in urban blocks (0-1, provided)

methodology: https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/urban-rural-continuum-codes/ (documented public code definitions for the 1-3 / 4-6 / 7-9 grouping)

strata.unit: provided USDA ERS metro flag
provided NCHS 2013 Urban/Rural Classification label

strata.unit: provided ACS tract total population
provided population per square kilometre of ALAND
methodology: https://www2.census.gov/geo/pdfs/reference/GARM/Ch11GARM.pdf (ALAND is land area in square metres; density is population per km2)

strata.unit: provided flag for any tribal land intersection
provided share of tract population on tribal land (0-1)

provided flag for statistical (non-legal) tribal area intersection
provided SVI overall vulnerability percentile (0-1)
methodology: https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/geographies-and-data/tsvi.html (CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index; bands here are analyst-chosen fixed edges on the provided 0-1 scale, not organiser bins)

strata.unit: provided USDM summer percent of tract area at D2 or worse
provided mean PDSI/PMDI moisture anomaly
provided USFS wildfire exposure probability for the highest flame-length class

strata.unit: provided MTBS mapped wildfire ever intersecting the tract

provided Fires On Demand human-caused ignition share
provided GEHE mean days above WBGT 30 C

provided CarbonPlan relative probability of flood score (2011 baseline)

descriptive_only_not_an_accuracy_claim.note: Group means describe how the frozen candidate's own emitted scores are distributed. They are not estimates of any organiser coverage-gap target and must not be read as accuracy.
